environmentVariables.name: BLS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. BLS allows 25 macro queries a day without a key; a free key raises it to 500 and extends history from 10 to 20 years.

servers.title: hypruse
servers.description: Computer use for Hyprland: semantic desktop state over IPC, plus vision and native input

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: How captures are returned: 'file' writes to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and returns the path, 'image' returns the image inline. Use 'image' for clients that render MCP images but cannot read files, such as Claude Desktop.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only the observation tools (desktop, screenshot, zoom, ui, marks, binds, wait_for). The agent can see and narrate but cannot click, type, or launch.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_CONFINE
environmentVariables.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_MARK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in clipboard tool (never in read-only mode). Off by default because clipboards hold passwords.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL
environmentVariables.description: Record every tool call, refusals included, as one NDJSON line: 1 writes to XDG_STATE_HOME/hypruse/journal.ndjson, or give a path. Read it back with 'hypruse journal'. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Rotate the journal once it reaches this size, keeping one previous generation alongside it. Set 0 to never rotate.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_TEXT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to record typed and copied text in the journal verbatim instead of as a length plus digest. Off by default because keystrokes are passwords; needed only to replay typing.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_DRYRUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for a rehearsal: every acting tool validates its arguments and runs every trust guard, then reports what it would have done and delivers no input.

servers.installCommand: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE=<value> HYPRUSE_READONLY=<value> HYPRUSE_CONFINE=<value> HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD=<value> HYPRUSE_STRICT=<value> HYPRUSE_MARK=<value> HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD=<value> HYPRUSE_JOURNAL=<value> HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES=<value> HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_TEXT=<value> HYPRUSE_DRYRUN=<value> uvx hypruse@0.10.0

environmentVariables.name: KUBECONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the kubeconfig inside the container. Must match the mount destination. There is no fallback to ~/.kube/config and no in-cluster config: a missing, unreadable or malformed file is a startup failure rather than a silent downgrade to an ambient credential.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_NAMESPACES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated namespaces the server may read, e.g. staging,production. Wildcards (* and all) are rejected at startup, and kube-system and kube-public are stripped even if listed. This is defense-in-depth, not the security boundary — the boundary is the ServiceAccount's RBAC bindings.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR. All logging goes to stderr; stdout carries the JSON-RPC stream exclusively.

environmentVariables.name: API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Kubernetes API request timeout. Must be a positive integer.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_LOG_LINES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum log lines any single get_pod_logs call may return. Must be a positive integer; clamped to a hard ceiling of 1000 with a warning.

servers.description: ZIP MCP server: create, inspect, verify, extract securely, modify without recompression. 13 tools

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the one sandbox directory: zipPath / sourcePath inputs are read from it and outputMode='file' / outputDir outputs are written under it (never overwritten; the real path of every file read and of every parent written must stay inside — a planted symlink or junction is SECURITY_VIOLATION). Unset: every tool works on base64 only (no file I/O beyond the opt-in cache).

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches zipPath / sourcePath inputs, file output, defaultDate='now', parallel, describe_engine or draft_governance_issue.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port (POST /mcp) instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless, legacy fallback). Unauthenticated unless ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace; a weaker value refuses to start). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Compared constant-time, never logged.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntryUncompressedSize and limits.maxTotalUncompressedSize in bytes (default 8589934592 = 8 GiB, the engine default). Integer >= 1024, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. A per-call value above it is refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntries and scan_zip_forward maxEntries (default 100000, the engine default; the scanner's default budget of 10000 is clamped to it, only an explicit value above it is refused). Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_WORKERS
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for create_zip parallel.workers (default 8; with no explicit workers the engine default max(1, min(cores - 1, 8)) applies, bounded by this ceiling; 0 disables worker threads and keeps compression on the calling thread). Integer >= 0, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your wallet's private key/seed for the chosen chain. Optional: omit it to run read-only (discover/quote/register/budget/guide); set it to let the agent pay. Stays on your machine; the spend policy caps every payment.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Chain to pay on (default: base).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAINS
environmentVariables.description: Pay across several chains (instead of PIPRAIL_CHAIN): a comma-separated list, e.g. base,polygon,solana. Give each its own PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_KEY (+ optional PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL). The agent pays whichever chain a 402 asks for — the first listed that can settle — under one shared budget.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_AMOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Max spend per single payment, in token units (default: 0.10).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime spend cap per token, in token units (default: 10.00).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL_DENOM
environmentVariables.description: Cross-token GRAND TOTAL: one spend cap per denomination across every stablecoin and chain, e.g. USD:20.00,EUR:5.00. Not a price oracle — sums tokens of the same unit, each counted 1:1. Native coins are excluded.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime cap on the NUMBER of payments, across every chain + token (e.g. 100).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_WINDOW
environmentVariables.description: Cap on the number of payments within PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS (a rolling rate limit; set PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS too).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_WARN_AT_FRACTION
environmentVariables.description: Emit an early-warning event when spend crosses this fraction of any cap, e.g. 0.8 (80%). Needs PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG to be visible.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SPEND_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local append-only spend log. When set, the budget (lifetime, grand total, counts) SURVIVES a restart — hydrated from this file. No backend; you own the file.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Mirror payment events (settled / declined / budget-threshold) as one-line JSON to 'stderr' or a file path — the operator's notification stream. Default: off.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed token symbols, plus the alias 'native' for the chain's coin (default: USDC).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SCHEMES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated payment schemes to settle (default: onchain-proof). Add 'exact' (onchain-proof,exact) to also pay standard x402 servers GASLESS on EVM + Solana (method auto-selected). Add 'upto' to also pay metered x402 servers on EVM (Permit2): sign a MAX, the server settles the actual <= max.

environmentVariables.name: CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to your configuration file

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_STATIC_FALLBACK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to allow HTTP startup when config.json has static credentials. Otherwise the server refuses to start, preventing silent shared-identity fallback for unauthenticated requests.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONTENT_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Byte cap for the content bodies and result blocks tools return (wikitext, rendered HTML, diffs, statement and row listings). An oversized response is truncated with a trailing marker describing what was left out.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_FILE_DATA_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on the base64-encoded size of a get-file-data response. A transport/safety backstop; callers tune actual size with the tool's width parameter. Over-cap responses error rather than truncate.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Minimum severity for logger output (stderr telemetry and sendLoggingMessage broadcast). Invalid values fail loudly on first log call.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY
environmentVariables.description: Maximum HTTP request body size on the StreamableHTTP transport. Accepts size strings like 1mb or 512kb.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_METRICS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose Prometheus metrics at GET /metrics on the HTTP transport. Has no effect on the stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECTS
environmentVariables.description: Additional allowed redirect URIs for hosted-proxy client registration: comma-separated exact URIs (which must include a host) and https prefix patterns ending in /*. Loopback, claude.ai, and verified first-party clients (ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) are always allowed; unset means no additional clients.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_CIMD_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated additional client_id document hosts trusted for CIMD (bare host or host:port). Verified first-party hosts are always trusted.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Override the default OAuth credentials store path. Default: ~/.config/mediawiki-mcp/credentials.json on Linux/macOS, %APPDATA%\mediawiki-mcp\credentials.json on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_NO_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip launching a browser during the OAuth dance and log the auth URL to stderr instead. Useful in headless environments and CI.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_PROXY_STORE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the hosted OAuth proxy's encrypted state file, which lets sign-ins survive restarts. Default: proxy-store.enc under the mediawiki-mcp config dir; /app/data/proxy-store.enc in the Docker image.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the request-derived public URL used in the protected-resource discovery doc and WWW-Authenticate header. Set this when running behind a proxy that rewrites the request Host.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for in-flight /mcp calls to drain on SIGTERM/SIGINT before exiting. Capped at 600000.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Type of MCP server transport

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Memory cap on the server-side fetch used by upload-file-from-url and update-file-from-url. Files larger than this are routed to the wiki's own copy-upload instead of being buffered by the server. Guards this server's memory, not the wiki's $wgMaxUploadSize.

environmentVariables.name: PORT

servers.name: io.github.sweir1/obsidian-brain
servers.title: Obsidian Brain
servers.description: Obsidian MCP server: semantic search, knowledge graph, and vault editing. No plugin required.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (or any folder of .md files).

environmentVariables.name: DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to store the SQLite index + embedding cache. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/obsidian-brain or ~/.local/share/obsidian-brain.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET
environmentVariables.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIM
environmentVariables.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX
environmentVariables.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL
environmentVariables.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.

environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC endpoint used for on-chain lookups. Defaults to mainnet-beta.

environmentVariables.description: Path to the agent's identity keystore. Auto-generated at ~/.xete/identity.json on first run.

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a Solana keypair, used for on-chain actions such as claiming a name. Not required to send or receive messages.

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the %alias permit server — the separate service that prices a %name and co-signs the claim transaction. Defaults to XETE_SERVER_URL. Must be https:// unless the host is loopback. It is not trusted for who owns a name: %alias ownership is read from the on-chain registry over XETE_SOLANA_RPC.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SOLANA_RPC
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC used to read the %alias registry, the source of truth for which wallet a %name points to. Defaults to https://solana-rpc.publicnode.com (api.mainnet-beta throttles reads).

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_MAX_LAMPORTS
environmentVariables.description: Client-side spend limit: the most a single transaction may cost, in lamports. Enforced before anything is signed. Unset means the conservative default, never unlimited.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_LAMPORTS
environmentVariables.description: Client-side spend limit: the most that may be spent in total, in lamports, inside the rolling window. Unset means the conservative default, never unlimited.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Length in seconds of the rolling window that XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_LAMPORTS applies to. Spending is recorded on disk, so the window survives a restart.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_FLOOR_LAMPORTS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum charged against the spend budget for any on-chain action, covering the account rent and network fees that a quoted price excludes.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_LEDGER
environmentVariables.description: Where spending is recorded so the rolling window survives a restart. Defaults to ~/.xete/spend-ledger.json; the identity keystore alongside it is never touched.

servers.name: team.gaijin/go-gerrit-mcp
servers.title: Gerrit Code Review
servers.description: Capability-gated Gerrit code review tools with opt-in review notifications pushed into the session

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Gerrit instance

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Account username for HTTP authentication

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: HTTP password or token of the account

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_MCP_GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated capability groups to enable: read, comment, transition

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_MCP_PROJECTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Gerrit project allowlist confining every operation

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_MCP_OWN_CHANGES_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Refuse trail-leaving operations on changes not owned by the authenticated account

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Enable review notifications: poll Gerrit for activity on subscribed changes and push it into the agent's session (requires a client with channel support)

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_POLL_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Poll cadence for subscribed changes, as a Go duration

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_INCLUDE_OWN
environmentVariables.description: Keep the authenticated account's own activity in review notifications

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_EXCLUDE_ACCOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated usernames or numeric account IDs whose activity never becomes a review notification

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated regular expressions; matching message or comment text never becomes a review notification

servers.installCommand: GERRIT_URL=<value> GERRIT_USERNAME=<value> GERRIT_TOKEN=<value> GERRIT_MCP_GROUPS=<value> GERRIT_MCP_PROJECTS=<value> GERRIT_MCP_OWN_CHANGES_ONLY=<value> GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS=<value> GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_POLL_INTERVAL=<value> GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_INCLUDE_OWN=<value> GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_EXCLUDE_ACCOUNTS=<value> GERRIT_MCP_REVIEW_NOTIFICATIONS_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=<value> docker run -i --rm ghcr.io/gaijinentertainment/go-gerrit-mcp:1.1.3
